articles.title: FTC Pause On Express Scripts Settlement And What It Means For Cigna
articles.mainIdea: FTC Pause On Express Scripts Settlement And What It Means For Cigna
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: FTC Pause On Express Scripts Settlement And What It Means For Cigna. The Federal Trade Commission has paused its settlement review involving Express Scripts, a key Pharmacy Benefit Manager tied to Cigna Group's Evernorth segment. This pause directly affects Cigna Group (NYSE:CI) because Express Scripts operates as a core subsidiary in its health services and PBM businesses.
